label: school week
description: A week of lessons and obligations; reactions and weekly marks reset when it ends.

label: school year
description: The end of a school year: the College Cup is decided, stress clears, and every student gains a Year and four Advancement points.

effects.text: The school year ends: the College Cup is reset after its final totals are logged, and every character gains a Year and four Advancement points to spend on a stat, a spell, a subject, and a talent.
